title: Perimeter anti-theft alarm component locations
introduction:
I use this drawing as a treasure map with the bodywork made transparent. Start with the blue highlighted assemblies on the car, follow their leader lines to the enlarged views, then match each inset’s callout to the table’s Item and Description columns.

The upper inset leads to the latch assembly at the front of the car. Its hood-ajar switch is integrated into the latch, so the switch is not depicted as a separate nearby component. The lower inset leads to the sensor assembly at the front of the cabin roof. The enlarged views help identify the assemblies; the transparent vehicle view establishes their locations.

This reference is complete as a component locator. It provides no removal route, electrical test, alarm operating sequence or fault conclusion.
